These are the original browser geometry, timing and Component helpers required by Cube Slam. They are checked in so builds never fetch unversioned Git branches or depend on the discontinued Component registry. `sources.json` records each upstream repository and exact commit; component manifests list the included module files. Upstream license notices and README files are preserved in each directory. jQuery and Mousetrap come from the pinned npm lockfile. The retired RTC client is replaced by `lib/rtc.js`.
